name: Wood Log
description: Sturdy timber chopped from forest trees. Essential for crafting and construction.

name: Rough Stone
description: Heavy stones collected from rocky outcrops. Used for tools and sturdy structures.

name: Plant Fiber
description: Tough botanical fibers harvested from wilderness foliage. Used for cordage and weaving.

name: Wild Berries
description: Sweet, juicy berries gathered from shrubs. Restores a small amount of vitality.

name: Raw Rabbit
description: Lean game meat. Nutritious and filling when cooked over a campfire.

name: Stone Axe
description: A crude axe fashioned from river stone and bound with fiber. Effective for felling trees.

name: Stone Pickaxe
description: A pointed stone head lashed to a hardwood branch. Good for breaking boulders and mining.

name: Campfire
description: A comforting ring of stones with dry logs. Provides warmth, light, and a place to cook.

name: Wood Wall
description: A reinforced wooden partition to shelter your base from the wilderness.

name: Simple Bed
description: A cozy thatch mattress on a wooden frame. Rest here to sleep through the cold night.
